arxiv-2010-15374.title: A New Bound on Odd Multicrossing Numbers of Knots and Links
arxiv-2010-15374.creator: Anshul Guha
arxiv-2010-15374.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Anshul Guha. An n n -crossing projection of a link L L is a projection of L L onto a plane such that n n points on L L are superimposed on top of each other at every crossing.

arxiv-2108-10267.title: A statistical approach for enhancing security in VANETs with efficient rogue node detection using fog computing
arxiv-2108-10267.creator: Anirudh Paranjothi ∗ , Mohammed Atiquzzaman
arxiv-2108-10267.description: Abstract Rogue nodes broadcasting false information in beacon messages may lead to catastrophic consequences in Vehicular Ad Hoc Networks (VANETs). Previous researchers used either cryptography, trust scores, or past vehicle data to detect rogue nodes; however, these methods suffer from high processing delay, overhead, and False-Positive Rate (FPR).

arxiv-2110-13948.title: Boosted CVaR Classification
arxiv-2110-13948.creator: Runtian Zhai, Chen Dan, Arun Sai Suggala, Zico Kolter, Pradeep Ravikumar
arxiv-2110-13948.description: Abstract Many modern machine learning tasks require models with high tail performance, i.e. high performance over the worst-off samples in the dataset. This problem has been widely studied in fields such as algorithmic fairness, class imbalance, and risk-sensitive decision making.

arxiv-2303-03837.title: On the conclusive detection of Majorana zero modes: conductance spectroscopy, disconnected entanglement entropy and the fermion parity noise
arxiv-2303-03837.creator: Arnav Arora, Abhishek Kejriwal, Bhaskaran Muralidharan
arxiv-2303-03837.description: Abstract Semiconducting nanowires with strong Rashba spin-orbit coupling in the proximity with a superconductor and under a strong Zeeman field can potentially manifest Majorana zero modes at their edges and are a topical candidate for topological superconductivity. However, protocols for their detection based on the local and the non-local conductance spectroscopy have been subject to intense scrutiny.

arxiv-2305-16341.title: TaxoKnow: Taxonomy as Prior Knowledge in the Loss Function of Multi-class Classification
arxiv-2305-16341.creator: Mohsen Pourvali, Yao Meng, Chen Sheng, Yangzhou Du
arxiv-2305-16341.description: Abstract In this paper, we investigate the effectiveness of integrating a hierarchical taxonomy of labels as prior knowledge into the learning algorithm of a flat classifier. We introduce two methods to integrate the hierarchical taxonomy as an explicit regularizer into the loss function of learning algorithms.

arxiv-2410-19190.title: A novel longitudinal rank-sum test for multiple primary endpoints in clinical trials: Applications to neurodegenerative disorders
arxiv-2410-19190.creator: Xiaoming Xu, Dhrubajyoti Ghosh, Sheng LuoDepartment of Biostatistics and BioinformaticsDuke University, Durham, NC, USA
arxiv-2410-19190.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Xiaoming Xu, Dhrubajyoti Ghosh, Sheng LuoDepartment of Biostatistics and BioinformaticsDuke University, Durham, NC, USA. Neurodegenerative disorders such as Alzheimer’s disease (AD) present a significant global health challenge, characterized by cognitive decline, functional impairment, and other debilitating effects. Current AD clinical trials often assess multiple longitudinal primary endpoints to comprehensively evaluate treatment efficacy. Traditional methods, however, may fail to capture global treatment effects, require larger sample sizes due to multiplicity adjustments, and may not fully exploit multivariate longitudinal data.

arxiv-2411-17405.title: Existence and uniqueness results for a nonlinear Budiansky-Sanders shell model
arxiv-2411-17405.creator: Trung Hieu Giang 1,2
arxiv-2411-17405.description: Abstract . A nonlinear shell model is studied in this paper. This is a nonlinear variant of the Budiansky-Sanders linear shell model. Under some suitable assumptions on the magnitude of the applied force, we will prove the existence of a minimizer for this shell model.

arxiv-2412-03454.title: Decoding Long-duration Gravitational Waves from Binary Neutron Stars with Machine Learning: Parameter Estimation and Equations of State
arxiv-2412-03454.creator: Qian Hu, Jessica Irwin, Qi Sun, Christopher Messenger, Lami Suleiman, Ik Siong Heng, John Veitch
arxiv-2412-03454.description: Abstract Gravitational waves (GWs) from binary neutron stars (BNSs) offer valuable understanding of the nature of compact objects and hadronic matter, and the science potential will be greatly enhanced by the third-generation (3G) GW detectors, which are expected to detect BNS signals with order-of-magnitude improvements in duration, detection rates, and signal strength.

arxiv-2412-08297.title: Quantum theory for nonlinear optical effects in the ultra-strong light-matter coupling regime
arxiv-2412-08297.creator: Thomas Krieguer, Yanko Todorov
arxiv-2412-08297.description: Abstract We present a microscopic quantum theory for nonlinear optical phenomena in semiconductor quantum well heterostructures operating in the regime of ultra-strong light matter coupling regime. This work extends the Power-Zienau-Wooley (PZW) formulation of quantum electrodynamics to account for nonlinear interactions based on a fully fermionic approach, without resorting to any bosonization approximation.

arxiv-2508-02880.title: Evaluation of 3D Counterfactual Brain MRI Generation
arxiv-2508-02880.creator: Pengwei Sun, Wei Peng, Lun Yu Li, Yixin Wang, Kilian M. Pohl
arxiv-2508-02880.description: Abstract Counterfactual generation offers a principled framework for simulating hypothetical changes in medical imaging, with potential applications in understanding disease mechanisms and generating physiologically plausible data. However, generating realistic structural 3D brain MRIs that respect anatomical and causal constraints remains challenging due to data scarcity, structural complexity, and the lack of standardized evaluation protocols.

pmc-11655323.title: Clinical perspectives on the value of testing for STK11 and KEAP1 mutations in advanced NSCLC
pmc-11655323.creator: Michelle Shiller, Melissa Johnson, Robert Auber, Sandip Pravin Patel
pmc-11655323.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Standard first-line therapy for patients with metastatic non-small cell lung cancer (mNSCLC) without identified actionable mutations consists of regimens comprising immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs), alone or in combination with platinum-based chemotherapy (CTx). However, approximately 20–30% of patients with mNSCLC (including some patients with high tumor programmed cell death ligand-1 expression) display primary resistance to ICIs, either alone or in combination with CTx.

pmc-12730955.title: The Effect of Mild Cyclic Loads on the Stress State of Degenerative Knee Joint Cartilages: A Numerical Study Aided by Experimental Data
pmc-12730955.creator: Oleg Ardatov, Vaiga Zemaitiene, Eiva Bernotiene, Arturas Kilikevicius
pmc-12730955.description: Background/Objectives: This study investigates the effect of mild cyclic loads on the stress state of degenerative knee joint cartilages using a combination of experimental data and numerical modeling. Methods: A three-dimensional finite element model of the knee joint was developed based on CT scans, incorporating key components such as the femur, tibia, cartilage layers, and meniscus.

pmc-12749946.title: Polymer-tethered pyridine tunes activities of the two distinct CO2 electroreduction sites on Cu
pmc-12749946.creator: Fan Zeng, Xuan Wang, Tianxiu Yin, Jinglei Shen, Binbin Pan, Wenzhi Teng, Tao Cheng, Yuhang Wang
pmc-12749946.description: CO2 electroreduction (CO2RR) to multi-carbon products on Cu was found to occur via a two-site mode: one site is more active for CO2-to-CO conversion, and the other is primarily responsible for CO reduction. However, it remains unclear whether the activities of these two sites can be modulated independently.

pmc-13013480.title: Associations of parental academic achievement pressure, support, and school climate with hikikomori tendency among high school students

pmc-13079026.title: The gut-liver axis in animal diseases: roles, mechanisms, and veterinary clinical applications
pmc-13079026.creator: Fuwan Peng, Shijie Tang, Yutong Cui, Yuyou Zeng
pmc-13079026.description: The liver serves as the core organ for metabolism, detoxification, and immune regulation in animals. Its functional homeostasis directly determines the animal's health status and production performance. The gut-liver axis, as a critical inter-organ regulatory network connecting the intestine and the liver, plays a vital role in regulating immune responses, maintaining nutritional metabolism balance, and preventing pathogen invasion.

pmc-13223368.title: Vertebral fracture caused by electric shock: case report and systematic review
pmc-13223368.creator: Dan Liu, Xin Chen, Jingming Wang, Kai Wu, Fangda Geng, Weimin Huang
pmc-13223368.description: ObjectiveThis study aims to explore the clinical characteristics of spinal fractures resulting from electric shock injuries. By analyzing a rare case of spinal fractures following electric shock, combined with a review of existing literature, we aim to provide clinicians with guidance on the diagnosis and treatment of such injuries.
